items.raw_excerpt: Sapta Tandavam showcases Shiva's cosmic dance through Kuchipudi and Kakatiyam at Ravindra Bharathi, celebrating Telangana's rich cultural heritage.
items.summary_en: Sapta Tandavam shows Shiva's cosmic dance through Kuchipudi and Kakatiyam dance forms. The performance took place at Ravindra Bharathi in Hyderabad. It celebrates Telangana's rich cultural heritage.
items.summary_ko: 삽타 탄다밤은 쿠치푸디와 카카티얌 춤으로 시바의 우주 춤을 선보인다. 공연은 하이데라바드의 라빈드라 바라티에서 열렸다. 텔랑가나의 풍부한 문화유산을 기리는 무대다.

items.raw_excerpt: The polar blast sweeping the country lead to some hair-raising flying conditions in Christchurch on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: A polar blast swept across New Zealand on Tuesday. It brought wild weather to Christchurch. An Air New Zealand plane had to abort its landing because of the strong wind.

items.raw_excerpt: Curitiba recebe revitalizações em suas áreas de lazer com a instalação de novos parquinhos. Confira todos!
items.summary_en: Curitiba is renovating its leisure areas with new playgrounds. More than 20 playgrounds are spread across the whole city. Residents can find a new playground near their home.
